mintAuthority.summary: Anchorage Digital Bank issues USDPT on Solana. The Token-2022 mint retains an externally owned mint/permanent-delegate authority plus separate metadata, pause, and freeze authorities, so durable supply remains under issuer-controlled keys.

controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 432540329, the official Token-2022 mint reports this system-owned address as both mintAuthority and permanentDelegate; the account is non-executable with zero data, the Solana equivalent of an externally controlled wallet.

review.evidence: Western Union identifies Anchorage Digital Bank as issuer and publishes the official mint. At finalized slot 432540329, Solana RPC confirms Token-2022 mint authority, permanent delegate, pause authority, freeze authority, and metadata authorities remain live system-owned wallet addresses. Anchorage publishes monthly Big Four AICPA reserve examinations for USDPT, including the May 2026 report. The OCC's 30 April 2026 active-trust-bank list records Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A. under national charter 25243, establishing prudential supervision of the issuing bank.
